goal: Hebrew security-sensitivity classification with defense-oriented documents

domain_targets.name: טילים, טילים בליסטיים, מערכות יירוט והגנה אווירית

length_quotas: Preserve existing config/plan.json quotas of short 5%, sentence 40%, paragraph 35%, long 20% independently within labels.
domain_assignment_rules: Assign a domain only if the subject is substantively about that domain, not if it merely mentions a keyword.

For missile_systems, the text must concern a missile-related system, program, engineering governance, testing governance, training, procurement, maintenance policy, safety oversight, documentation, public education or organizational decision. A movie, unrelated publishing contract, or incidental word 'missile' does NOT qualify.
Distinguish public/educational information from internal operations, material non-public decisions, and exceptional systemic disclosures in all domains.
Track both primary_domain and optional secondary_domains outside text input.

Use invented organizations, projects and examples. Never include real classified information, actionable missile/weapons construction, deployment, targeting, launch sequences, explosive fabrication, precise performance parameters, or operational vulnerabilities.
Before checkpoint acceptance run domain coverage QA and review sampled assignments for contextual relevance. Numeric quotas alone do not prove semantic quality.
existing_data: General v1 and its pilot are archived and excluded from all v2 inputs.
